claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the product for giving a natural, healthy glow without looking sparkly or overly shiny.
Many reviewers highlight its versatility, noting it can be mixed with foundation or moisturizer, worn under foundation, or used alone as a highlight.
Several reviewers note that a little goes a long way and that using too much can make it look glittery rather than illuminated.
Some reviewers mention difficulty controlling the amount dispensed, leading to wasted product.
A few reviewers caution that it can emphasize deep wrinkles if applied to them.
